apps.notes: Billing: To bill is the total fees less what is billed. Bill on: the day you plan to bill a payment; Money today on the Today page reads it. Follow-ups keep their history: a changed date leaves the old one as a done or moved line. Messages inside a communication, one after another, like an email thread. Notes: bullets, numbering and indents. Your requests shows what you sent. A repeating task's next one is linked to Gantt like the first. Windows + Left or Right docks NodOne beside Chrome, and every page fits. Fixed: a crash that said "thread".
Client marks reach the PDF and Excel exports. Docks beside Chrome: the Money tab, Export, More columns and headers fit when narrow. Tala can read a whole schedule to put it into a NodOne project.

Opens a folder you name, after you approve its card. Tidies a folder on one card, with Undo; finds the same file kept twice. Compares a D: project folder with the project's NodOne Files. Puts a whole Gantt schedule into a NodOne project, and a hand-over carries the whole list. Knows follow-up lines, messages in a communication and Bill on dates. Tidier Excel drafts: header colours, aligned columns, filters, group rows. Home opens calm; the morning brief waits until you turn it on. Docks beside Chrome and fits when narrow. Fixed: several refusals when reading files, opening pages and drafting.
PDF tools open again. Report a problem, send logs and ask for something new from Settings. Docks beside Chrome with Windows + Left or Right; Home cards keep their names when docked.
App cards keep one size while updates come in. The Suite updates itself first, then the other apps. Docks beside Chrome with Windows + Left or Right.
